summary: Round 3 (Wave 2) security review and regression audit of commit 778bf7d verified 0 open P0-P3 vulnerabilities across universal allApps window targeting, 2.5s quiet + 1.2/1.5s fresh dwell input gating, cross-PID AX focus ladder, GitHub Actions workflows (ci.yml and pr-guardian.yml), and public-repo documentation, with all 8 prior security findings (SEC-001..SEC-008) remaining fixed without regression.

findings.title: Webcam and AX tracking reactivate while locked on screen-wake or spoofed DistributedNotification
findings.rationale: Remains closed in Round 3: `SystemSessionStateProvider` gates session activity strictly on `CGSessionCopyCurrentDictionary()` + workspace sleep state, and `AppController` / `FocusCoordinator` halt camera and AX operations when locked or asleep (T59, T78).

references.title: CWE-807: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision

findings.title: CGWindowCatalogService drops layer != 0 windows, blinding hit-testing to modal and auth dialogs
findings.rationale: Remains closed and strengthened in Round 3 (RC3, AW8): `WindowClassifier` + `Config.promptOwnerNames` now also map `CoreAuthUI` to `com.apple.LocalAuthentication.UIAgent`, retain Spotlight (`layer > 0`) as an `.occluder`, and enforce global `.securityPrompt` vetoes across all displays (T60, T61, T62, T77, T85).

references.title: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

findings.title: SafetyPolicy skips Config.hardBlocklist when requireAllowedSource is false and omits CoreAuthUI
findings.rationale: Remains closed and expanded for universal `allApps` mode in Round 3 (AW8, RC2): `DefaultSafetyGuardPolicy` and `Config.isBundleAllowed` unconditionally enforce `Config.isHardBlocked(_:)` (covering auth agents, System Settings, ScreenSharing, Spotlight, 1Password v7/v8, Apple Passwords, Bitwarden, Keychain Access, and `dev.ifocus.app` + runtime `Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier`), while nil/empty bundle IDs fail closed (T63, T84, T85).

findings.title: Build and app-signing scripts execute and sign binaries from predictable shared /tmp directories
findings.rationale: Remains closed in Round 3: `prepare_secure_dir()` and UID-scoped `/tmp` paths remain intact alongside the new CLT/Xcode toolchain probe (`AW4`), verified by `scripts/check-scripts.sh` (Gate G6).

references.title: CWE-379: Creation of Temporary File in Directory with Insecure Permissions

findings.title: Uninvalidated PID-keyed bundleIDCache misclassifies windows after macOS PID wraparound
findings.rationale: Remains closed in Round 3: `CGWindowCatalogService` resolves bundle IDs into a per-snapshot local dictionary with zero persistent PID cache.

references.title: CWE-672: Operation on a Resource after Expiration or Release

findings.title: SecureFileStore.read accepts group/world-writable config directories and uses path-based TOCTOU
findings.rationale: Remains closed in Round 3: descriptor-pinned `O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW` + `openat`/`renameat`/`unlinkat` and `0o077` directory permission rejection on `read()` remain intact (T34, T71).

references.title: CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

findings.title: FocusCoordinator appends unbounded DecisionLogEntry records at 20-30 Hz, leaking heap memory
findings.rationale: Remains closed in Round 3: `FocusCoordinator.decisionLog` remains bounded at 4096 entries via `RingBuffer` (T64).
